intent.rationale: Only the low nibble of the status output has a source; the upper nibble floats.

labels.note: The upper four bits of output y have no driver.

settlement.note: The declaration exposes y[7:4], which have no driver anywhere in the file. The low-nibble assignment is valid, so the undriven output is located at its declaration.
